title: RoleRequest
description: The fields the Stack reads on every JSON request to /v1/* (chat completions, embeddings, generations): `model` names a role (chat, embed, image, ...) or an installed model id; the rest is passed to the engine unchanged. The audio paths take spec/voice's multipart forms instead, with `model` and `timeout_ms` as optional text fields because each audio path serves one role. Declared here so Home builds requests against one shape; moves to shared/spec at the refocus's 0c.

model.description: A role id (`chat`, `coding`, `judge`, `router`, `embed`, `rerank`, `vision`, `stt`, `tts`, `wakeword`, `image`, `video`, `music`) or an installed model id.

quality.description: Generator roles only: which of the tiered models the sizing profile installed.
